# Supported tools

<!-- Generated by tools/make_supported_tools_doc.py from envs/locks/, the rule specs and the family modules; do not edit by hand. -->

The programs and libraries of the benchmark environments, with the versions recorded in
[`envs/locks/`](../envs/locks/), and the number of rules and task families per domain. Generated by
`tools/make_supported_tools_doc.py` from the lock files, the rule specs and the family modules; do
not edit by hand. `python tools/make_supported_tools_doc.py --check` fails when this page differs
from what the generator writes now.

Rules: [rule catalogue](rules.md). Families: [task families](families.md).

## Domains

| Domain | Tools | Rules | Families |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Read alignment | bwa, Bowtie 2, minimap2, HISAT2, STAR, samtools | 11 | 11 |
| RNA-seq quantification | featureCounts, HTSeq, Salmon, kallisto, RSEM, StringTie | 10 | 6 |
| Variants and genotypes | bcftools, VCFtools, plink, plink2, tabix, GATK, Picard | 19 | 12 |
| Intervals, peaks, liftover, coverage tracks | bedtools, BEDOPS, liftOver, deepTools, MACS3 | 26 | 12 |
| Sequence processing, search and multiple alignment | seqtk, seqkit, fastp, cutadapt, Trimmomatic, BLAST+, DIAMOND, MAFFT, MUSCLE, HMMER | 12 | 12 |
| Protein structure and protein-model plumbing | gemmi, Biopython, ProDy, MDAnalysis, mdtraj, RDKit, pdb-tools, TM-align, MMseqs2, mkdssp | 13 | 12 |
| Single-cell and virtual-cell inputs | scanpy, anndata, mudata, loompy | 14 | 12 |
| Original families | samtools, bcftools, bedtools | 3 | 28 |
| Total |  | 108 | 105 |

Rules are counted under the domain of the tool they watch; the 3 rules about data formats, which are
not about one tool, are counted under Original families. Families are counted under their pack, the
section of [task families](families.md) that lists them. A rule and the families it is written for
can therefore fall in different rows. `bcftools.regions_file_base` (F1) and
`bcftools.region_semantics` (F1, F7) are counted under Variants and genotypes, but all the families
they are written for are in Original families.

Models such as AlphaFold, Boltz, scGPT or GEARS are not run: the rules and families cover the files,
libraries and scripts around them. The one rule that watches a structure-prediction program,
`structure.chain_order`, is calibrated against `mockfold`, a CPU-only stand-in that ships in
[`src/biowarden/bench/fixtures/`](../src/biowarden/bench/fixtures/).

## Versions

Each version below is read from one lock file: the version of the named conda package, pip
distribution or binary. A table lists selected packages of its lock file, not all of them.

### Tool binaries and sandbox

These programs are recorded by their `--version` line, not by a conda package list, in
[`tool-versions.txt`](../envs/locks/tool-versions.txt), which also holds the sha256 of samtools,
bcftools and bedtools. The promotion table records samtools 1.24, bcftools 1.24 and bedtools 2.31.1
as the versions it was measured with, for all 108 rules.

| Name | Version |
|---|---|
| samtools | 1.24 |
| bcftools | 1.24 |
| bedtools | 2.31.1 |
| bubblewrap (the sandbox of the benchmark runner) | 0.4.0 |

## How the versions are pinned

- [`envs/locks/`](../envs/locks/) holds one explicit package list per conda environment (name,
  version, build, URL and sha256 of every package, no filesystem path), the `pip freeze --all` of
  the harness interpreter, and `tool-versions.txt`: the `--version` lines of samtools, bcftools,
  bedtools and bubblewrap, the Python version and the sha256 of the three binaries. This page prints
  names and versions only.
- `python tools/env_lock.py` writes the files from the live environments that its `tools.json` names
  (option `--tools-json`); `python tools/env_lock.py --check` compares the live environments with
  the files and exits 1 on a difference. The stage-2 job template (`tools/stage2_job.sbatch`) runs
  the check before its first trial unless `ENV_CHECK=0` is set.
- A package that was pip-installed inside a conda environment is not in the conda records and is not
  listed.
